minepapers.gui.title: Picture Settings
minepapers.gui.path.2: Full path to a folder with pictures (Ctrl+V to paste):
minepapers.gui.path.3: Direct link to a picture (http/https, Ctrl+V to paste):
minepapers.gui.hint.1: Pictures from the folder change in random order.
minepapers.gui.hint.3: The link must point to the image file itself, not to a page with it.
minepapers.gui.mode.0.tip: Panel: the picture sits on a 1-pixel thick canvas\nwith framed edges.
minepapers.gui.mode.1.tip: Realistic frame: the frame covers 2 pixels of the picture\nand sticks out above it, like a real painting.
minepapers.gui.mode.2.tip: Graffiti: no frame or canvas, pressed against the wall.\nA PNG with transparent background looks like a decal\n(a stain, a sign, a drawing on the wall).
minepapers.gui.border.empty.tip: Frame texture: default.\nHold a block or an item and click\nto make the frame from its texture.
minepapers.gui.border.default.tip: Frame texture: default.\nClick to use the texture of the held item:\n%s
minepapers.gui.border.custom.tip: Frame texture: %s.\nClick again to restore the default one.
minepapers.gui.pixels.tip: Checked - values are in pixels (1/16 block).\nUnchecked - in blocks.\nThe picture size is also its hitbox.
minepapers.gui.fit.0.tip: fill: the picture is stretched over the whole canvas.\nAspect ratio is not kept.
minepapers.gui.fit.1.tip: contain: the whole picture fits into the canvas\nkeeping its aspect ratio; empty margins remain.
minepapers.gui.fit.2.tip: cover: the picture covers the whole canvas\nkeeping its aspect ratio; overflow is cropped.
minepapers.gui.fit.3.tip: none: original size - 1 picture pixel per\n1 style pixel, centered, overflow is cropped.
minepapers.gui.fit.4.tip: scale-down: like none, but if the picture does not fit\nit is shrunk like contain.
minepapers.gui.style.tip:
Map palette - only the colors Minecraft maps can show,
like real map art.
Dithering mixes them for smooth gradients,
soft dithering - with less grain.
minepapers.gui.ppb.tip: Picture resolution in pixels per block.\n128 - like a map in a frame, 16 - like a vanilla painting.\nLower - bigger pixels and lighter for the game.
minepapers.gui.status.unknown: Press Done or Reload to load
minepapers.error.notFound: file, folder or link not found
minepapers.error.noImages: no pictures found (png, jpg, jfif, gif, bmp)
minepapers.error.notAbsolute: a full path is required, e.g. C:\Pictures
minepapers.error.badUrl: the link must start with http:// or https://
minepapers.error.notImage: the link is not a picture (png, jpg, gif, bmp are supported)
minepapers.gui.status.shared: Pictures on the server: %d - visible to all players
minepapers.gui.status.preparing: Preparing pictures for the server: %d of %d
minepapers.gui.status.uploading: Uploading pictures to the server: %d of %d
